facts.fact: Starlink launched commercially in Bangui on Monday (the week of the 19 March 2026 article) through a partnership between the government and DEVEA Centrafrique; standard kit about 265,000 CFA francs, monthly subscription 33,000 CFA francs, and 450 kits with 12-month subscriptions secured by the government.

note: Mentions Eutelsat OneWeb only as a pan-African rival, not as on sale in CAF.
